item.title: Find the flattest route between any two points in SF
item.description:
📝 Flatten SF by Drew Edwards Flatten SF flat routes across San Francisco From ⇅ To Walk Bike Copy link ShortestFlattest distance climbing steepest How this works Routes are computed in your browser over 160,000 street segments, using USGS 1 m lidar elevation and the Overture / OpenStreetMap street graph. Sliding right never shortens the route and never adds climbing. Faint lines show the other routes along the way.
🔗 Read more: https://flattensf.com/

item.title: Texas city demands $2M for public records on Flock usage
item.description:
📝 Klein’s Flock abuse—along with another cop’s—was outed after USA Today submitted a public records request that sparked a probe, then his arrest. Consider that the Tribune reported that the state Department of Public Safety has sought help from “the Attorney General’s Office to allow it to withhold the entirety” of Flock data that the Texas Tribune has requested. Flock misuse recently ruled unconstitutional Flock maintains that its automated license plate readers (ALPR) are designed for public safety, while courts have largely agreed that cops can reasonably access Flock databases without infringing Fourth Amendment rights.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/10/texas-city-demands-2m-for-public-records-on-flock-usage/
